subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Yesterday, I ate only a ________ of apples for my dinner.
solution: The correct answer is: "**pair**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Pair**" means two things that are the same and used together, such as a pair of shoes or a pair of earrings. (दो चीजें जो एक जैसी हैं और एक साथ उपयोग की जाती हैं) • **Example**: *She found the perfect pair of shoes for the party.* • In this context, the speaker ate a certain number of apples, and "**pair**" is the most appropriate option to indicate that number. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. **Complete sentence**: *Yesterday, I ate only a pair __of apples for my dinner.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Pier **is a structure that extends into a body of water, such as a dock or jetty. (एक संरचना जो पानी के शरीर में फैली हुई है) • **Pear **is a type of fruit that is similar to an apple but has a distinctive shape and texture. (एक प्रकार का फल जो सेब के समान होता है) • **Pare **means to remove the outer layer of something, such as peeling an apple. (किसी चीज़ की बाहरी परत को हटाना) 47:T84e, The correct answer is: **Nutrients**
